slot_rule: first divergence index of the source and target sub-token sequences; single-position mask; replacement edits only
normalisation: sub-tokens->word; words->edit; edits->example; examples->batch; keep is a flat mean over c words
keep_rule: plain mean over all c words (no before/after split)
batching: sentence is the unit; greedy budget over rows x padded width; every content sub-token masked once per sentence
selection: per-language thresholds, maximum pooled micro incorrect-class F0.5
